indications: Bromfenac Ophthalmic Solution 0.07% is indicated for the treatment of postoperative inflammation and reduction of ocular pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.
contraindications: Instill one drop into the affected eye once daily beginning 1 day prior to surgery, continued on the day of surgery, and through the first 14 days postsurgery. ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
Bromfenac Ophthalmic Solution 0.07% is supplied in a white LDPE plastic squeeze bottle with a 15 mm LDPE white dropper tip and 15 mm polypropylene gray cap as follows:
                  
                     NDC 82260-602-03 3 mL in a 7.5 mL bottle
                  
                  
                     Storage
                  
                  Store at 15ºC to 25ºC (59ºF to 77ºF). After opening, Bromfenac Ophthalmic Solution can be used until the expiration date on the bottle.
name: bromfenac ophthalmic solution
